race.comment: HELLENIC BELLE (8) produced a real eye-catcher first-up over this trip at Rosehill then struggled when asked to extend to 1300m last time. Looks a significant threat back to her right trip from a perfect gate. FROM ME TO YOU (12) led all the way and gave nothing else a chance on debut here at this trip last start. Impressive filly who looks ready to take on a field like this despite her inexperience. CELESTIAL CHARM (11) has not raced since bolting in over 1150m at the Kensington track in June. Trialling well and looks all set to pick up where she left off. SCURO STAR (10) is another promising filly who dominated first-up at Gosford. This is not beyond her. SAPPHIRE ROSE (6) resumes. Needed a run or two to hit her straps last prep but in a race that has fallen away she can figure in trifecta and first four discussions.
